paper.title_en: Connecting Heavy-Quarkonium Born-Oppenheimer EFT to the Peskin OPE
paper.abstract_en: We formulate a source-dependent QCD-to-BOEFT matching for the gluonic response of a normalized stable compact heavy-quarkonium state. A gauge-covariant complementary-space resolvent preserves the coupled BO dynamics: source-gapped propagation generates local inverse moments, while an independent kernel contains irreducible two-field matching. Together with locality and kernel analyticity, joint propagation-vertex bounds give sufficient conditions for a channel-factorized OPE. In the strict weak-coupling Bhanot--Peskin projection, the established electric moments and dissociation cut arise from inverse moments and the discontinuity of the same source-weighted spectral measure. As a magnetic extension, for a Coulombic spin-singlet $1S$ state the free-octet, local-matching result is $c_{B,GG}^{(1)ij}=5πα_s^2 (c_FV_{\rm iso}^{(s)})^2δ^{ij}/16$, while the covariant-kinetic seagull gives $c_{B,{\rm dia}}^{(1)ij}=-πα_s^2δ^{ij}/4$. These are separately identifiable contributions rather than the complete magnetic matching coefficient.
